children: Achieve Life Sciences’ third-quarter net loss narrowed year over year. Higher manufacturing and supply-chain costs and employee expenses were partly offset by lower clinical-trial costs following completion of the ORCA-OL trial in October 2025; a fair-value gain on warrant liabilities also lifted other income.
² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Basic and diluted net loss per common share”.
: The company intends to resubmit its smoking-cessation NDA naming Adare as finished drug product manufacturer in the fourth quarter of 2026.
: Achieve completed three commercial-scale stability batches at Adare’s facility and qualified all testing procedures at the site.
: The company anticipates potential smoking-cessation approval by the end of the second quarter of 2027, followed by a U.S. commercial launch.
: Cytisinicline has FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation and a Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher for vaping cessation.
